summary: EXP-451 STRESSTEST-P2 worked-example said "flat-plate resonator with the published exponentially-decaying firmament profile" predicts 22.6 Hz — but 22.6 Hz comes specifically from the linear-radial-averaged effective-height convention H_eff = H₀·(L/R)·(1−exp(−R/L)) ≈ 3,316 km, not the unaveraged pole height (which gives 8.77 Hz) nor area-weighted (35 Hz). Using 22.6 Hz without naming the convention mirrors the dome's own formula-switching behavior. EXP-568 chose Option B from the suggested_fix: revised STRESSTEST-P2.insert_text in place to name the linear-radial convention explicitly with parenthetical cross-reference to §2.1 listing all three. Range claim updated from "22-35 Hz" to "8.77-35 Hz across the three named conventions" — slightly stronger, adjacent-consistent with the §2.1 supremum-bound argument. Option A (switch to 8.77 Hz) was rejected because it would create cross-section inconsistency. EXP-551-orphan-iss2352 tracker entry flipped to complete this run. Close ISS-2352 as fixed-by EXP-568.
notes_for_decider: Do NOT flip EXP-451 to ready-for-integration on this closure alone — ISS-2518 (STRESSTEST-P2/P3 insert_after_text/sub_patches mechanics + P4 stale find_text) remains open. EXP-451 stays holes-being-revised.
